page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance configured on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. Powered by an arm64 AWS Graviton processor operating at 3.3 GHz, it delivers 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs without hyperthreading, maintaining a single thread per core. System memory totals 32.0 GB, establishing a allocation ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

Hardware capabilities include bundled local storage consisting of a 950 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. Network bandwidth maintains a baseline throughput of 8 Gbps. The server configuration includes zero GPU accelerators and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio optimizes hardware resource density for compute-heavy tasks rather than memory-bound operations. Integrated local NVMe SSD storage reduces reliance on external network-attached volumes for temporary data handling, though instance store storage remains ephemeral. The configuration is suitable for batch processing, software compilation, media encoding, and ETL workloads demanding persistent core throughput alongside high-speed local disk operations.
